//: agent-workflow-kit — repo-owned guard config. `update` never overwrites this file.
//ask: Extra regex patterns asked about before running. Shape: {"re": "...", "why": "..."}. Optional "tool": "Bash" | "PowerShell" scopes a rule to one shell.
//deny: Patterns refused outright, whatever the permission mode.
//askPaths: Plain substrings. Any command containing one is asked about. Use for paths that hold irreplaceable data (capture runs, datasets, device state).
//warn: Allowed, but the model gets a note (additionalContext) before running. Same shape as ask. For commands that are not destructive but have bitten before — a device tool that hangs without `timeout`, a flag that kills the wrong process.
//askTier: How the ask tier behaves in this repo: "ask" (default) prompts; "warn" turns every would-be prompt into a note for the model; "off" drops it. deny always applies. A user overrides it for every repo on their machine with the env var AGENT_KIT_GUARD_ASK (settings.json env block) — the personal switch wins.
